q1.sampleAnswer:
Dear Mr Smith,
It is great idea to have a party for our final Englis lesson of the term. All studens will be surprised!
I think we can go to the park because I think it will be great to do our party outsaid. Also we can make a picknik!
Of course! I can suggest lots of fun activities for practising English during our party.
I can make sandwides and find good music for dance.
See you soon,
English class

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：回应邮件中的四条笔记：①对举办期末派对表示赞同（Awesome!）；②说明在教室还是公园开派对更好并解释原因（Explain which would be better）；③建议派对上练习英语的有趣活动（Suggest …）；④说明自己能带什么到派对（Offer …）
交际效果：文体和语气符合任务要求，能清楚表达观点并吸引读者
条理性：结构清晰、衔接连贯，使用多种连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的丰富性与准确性

anchors.noteZh: 内容4/交际效果5/条理性5/语言4。回应了四个要点中的三个，没有具体建议练习英语的活动（缺第三点）；称呼和结尾得体，语气热情（It is great idea, Of course!），用 I think we can go to the park because 等功能性语言吸引读者；分段清楚，每段一个要点，连接词简单但准确（because, Also, and）；词汇恰当、语法简单准确，有 Englis, studens, outsaid, picknik, sandwides 等拼写错误，但不影响理解。

anchors.response:
Dear Mr Smith,
I think it’s a good idea to organise party, because I think, all children like partys and many other things connected with this word.
About place where we can organise it, I’ll choose park, because in park we can play some games, make a picnic. And in there, we all will breath with fresh air and listen to birds songs. Well, if it is English party, we can make some English competition or something else.
Oh, and If we will make a picnic, I can bring some food or drinks, like sandwiches and lemonade.
See you soon,
Nastya
anchors.noteZh: 内容5/交际效果3/条理性3/语言3。四个要点都充分回应；称呼和结尾得体，整体礼貌，但连接观点时用了 Well, if it is / Oh, and 等口语化表达，想法简单直接；分段合理，只用 because, and 等简单连接词；词汇恰当（play some games, fresh air, lemonade），语法准确但简单，以现在时和将来时为主，有缺冠词等错误（to organise party, About place），不影响理解。

q1.explanationZh: 满分邮件要逐一回应四条笔记：赞同办派对，说明并解释选教室还是公园，具体建议练英语的活动，并说出自己能带什么；语气友好得体，约 100 词。

q2.sampleAnswer:
It’s great having friends who go to a different school. Maybe you would think that you don’t see them so much as you see your friends of school. But, when you see your friends from another school you have an excellent time, you do amazing things. The most important thing is that they still are your friends doesn’t matter what.
Nowadays, you can easily keep in touch with your friends from another school because of all the electronic divices we have now. So you can chat them everyday.

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：文章回答两个问题：①有在别的学校上学的朋友有什么好处；②如果不在学校见面，和朋友保持联系难不难
交际效果：文体和语气符合任务要求，能清楚表达观点并吸引读者
条理性：结构清晰、衔接连贯，使用多种连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的丰富性与准确性

anchors.noteZh: 内容5/交际效果5/条理性5/语言4。两个问题都充分回答并展开；文体恰当，直接与读者对话（Maybe you would think that…）吸引读者；条理清楚，客观呈现正反两方面观点（Maybe you would think… But, when you see…），但全文只有 88 词，衔接手段展示有限；日常词汇运用恰当（excellent time, amazing things, chat），尝试多种句式但并非都正确（doesn’t matter what, chat them, divices）。

anchors.response:

I have lots of friends that go to a different school and I really like to hang out with them when I can. Plus that friends can present you their friends and so, like that, you end having lots of them. I love having friends.
anchors.noteZh: 内容5/交际效果4/条理性4/语言3。两个问题都有回答；写到个人情况、引人入胜，用 In my opinion 等表达观点，想法简单直接；两段分别回答两个问题，使用 because, and, Plus 及 who, them, that 等衔接；词汇适合话题（hang out, social media），但 friends, school 反复出现，句式简单、较复杂的句子来自题目，有 thats, everything it’s easier 等错误，不影响理解。

q2.explanationZh: 满分文章要回答两个问题并给出理由或例子，用适合网站文章的语气吸引读者，分段清楚、衔接自然，约 100 词。

q3.sampleAnswer: Ben and his father got off the plane and left the airport. Ben was very delighted with their trip to Germany. Because he had been dreaming to go there for a lol of time. On their way to home they visited a café and ate delishious and unforgetable steak. with baked potatoes. When they came home, their mother was doing the washig up, Ben’s little brother was playing with toy cars and his sister was trilying to repair her doll. They were very happy to see Ben and father. After they had lunch, Ben started telling about his holidays. He also showed a lot of pictures and his family liked it very much.

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：故事以给定的句子开头（Ben 和爸爸下飞机离开机场），情节与开头句相关、合乎逻辑，有清楚的开头、发展和结尾
交际效果：文体和语气符合任务要求，能清楚表达观点并吸引读者
条理性：结构清晰、衔接连贯，使用多种连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的丰富性与准确性

anchors.response: Ben and his father got off the plane and left the airport. Ben was very delighted with their trip to Germany. Because he had been dreaming to go there for a lol of time. When they came home, their mother was doing the washig up, Ben’s little brother was playing with toy cars and his sister was trilying to repair her doll. They were very happy to see Ben and father. After they had lunch, Ben started telling about his holidays. He also showed a lot of pictures and his family liked it very much.
anchors.noteZh: 内容5/交际效果4/条理性4/语言4。故事承接开头句有逻辑地展开；用多种叙事时态交代事情先后（had been dreaming, was doing），用 delighted, delishious 等描述性词语吸引读者；用 On their way to, When, After 等衔接，有几处标点误用（to Germany. Because; steak. with）；时态运用熟练，描写回家时每人在做什么的句子尤其出彩，有 lol of time, washig, trilying 等小拼写错误，不影响理解。

anchors.response: They had amazing holidays together. It was their tour of Europe. They were in Germany, France, Great Britain and USA. Ben and his father visited different museums, art galleries. They were walking in the streets connected with some historical events. They practiced English a lot. Family also made a lot of photoes for their album. Ben visited concerts of his favourite bands and singers and made photoes with them. It was really great expiairence. After this amazing trip they were very tired and wanted to sleep a lot.
anchors.noteZh: 内容5/交际效果4/条理性3/语言4。虽然没有写出开头句，但故事显然接着开头句展开；讲法简单直白，罗列 Ben 和爸爸度假做的事，结尾恰当（After this amazing trip…）；全文是一连串短句，缺少连接词，句子多以 They 开头，更像事件罗列；日常词汇恰当（museums, art galleries, album），句子准确但简单，过去时种类单一。

q3.explanationZh: 满分故事要用给定句开头，围绕 Ben 和爸爸回来之后的事展开连贯的情节，用多种过去时态和连接词交代先后顺序，有清楚的结尾，约 100 词。
